name: 0001_initial_schema
migration_requirement: Replay through the canonical Zed migration authority before importing Buzz rows
summary: Creates the multitenant event log, communities, channels, membership, tokens, workflows, audit records, projections, and partitions.

name: 0002_git_repo_names
migration_requirement: Preserve the NIP-34 repository-name uniqueness and ownership contract
summary: Adds the community-scoped Git repository-name registry.

name: 0003_community_icon
migration_requirement: Preserve the per-community NIP-11 icon value
summary: Adds workspace icon metadata to communities.

name: 0004_events_tags_gin
migration_requirement: Recreate the tag-query index after canonical event import
summary: Adds the partition-aware GIN index for event tags.

name: 0005_agent_turn_metric_fts
migration_requirement: Keep encrypted agent metrics excluded from searchable text
summary: Rebuilds full-text search with agent-turn metrics excluded.

name: 0006_moderation
migration_requirement: Import reports bans timeouts and actions without crossing community boundaries
summary: Adds moderation reports community bans and moderation actions.

name: 0007_nip_rs_retention
migration_requirement: Preserve bounded NIP-RS retention replacement ordering and watermarks
summary: Adds parameterized-event watermarks and bounded encrypted read-state retention.

name: 0008_fresh_install_search_allowlist
migration_requirement: Apply the positive FTS allowlist to fresh canonical installations
summary: Restricts indexed event kinds to the approved search allowlist.

name: 0009_nip_rs_database_guards
migration_requirement: Retain mixed-version NIP-RS database guards until all compatibility clients pass the exact-replay floor
summary: Adds database retention guards for mixed NIP-RS client versions.

name: 0010_nip_rs_exact_replay_guard
migration_requirement: Import exact replay watermarks and supersede only through the approved compatibility gate
summary: Replaces approximate NIP-RS replay behavior with exact watermark enforcement.

name: 0011_nip_rs_exact_tag_cardinality
migration_requirement: Preserve exact NIP-RS tag cardinality checks at canonical ingress
summary: Adds exact tag-cardinality guards for encrypted read-state events.

name: 0012_push_leases
migration_requirement: Import encrypted push leases and the wake outbox without exposing ciphertext to projections
summary: Adds durable push leases endpoint state and wake-delivery outbox records.

name: 0013_push_endpoint_state
migration_requirement: Preserve generation-scoped endpoint invalidation during gateway migration
summary: Adds generation tracking and invalidation state for push endpoints.

name: 0014_push_lease_fts
migration_requirement: Keep push-lease ciphertext excluded from canonical FTS
summary: Removes encrypted push-lease payloads from the searchable event allowlist.

name: 0015_push_gateway_authority
migration_requirement: Move global gateway challenges installations delegations quotas and replay state under one approved authority
summary: Adds deployment-global push gateway authority tables and expiry indexes.

name: 0016_community_archival
migration_requirement: Import archive state separately from access revocation and deletion
summary: Adds reversible community archival state.

name: 0017_product_feedback
migration_requirement: Preserve signed feedback attribution and moderation visibility
summary: Adds signed product-feedback persistence.

name: 0018_push_match_queue
migration_requirement: Import pending event-to-push matches with idempotency and reconciliation
summary: Adds the durable push matching queue.

name: 0019_mesh_status_retention
migration_requirement: Preserve bounded mesh-status retention without treating it as compute-job authority
summary: Adds retention rules for shared-compute mesh status events.

name: 0020_join_policy_acceptances
migration_requirement: Import versioned acceptance evidence and fail closed when policy versions cannot be resolved
summary: Adds versioned community join-policy acceptance records.

name: 0021_created_at_fence_floor
migration_requirement: Preserve the commit-time created-at floor across replicas before enabling writes
summary: Adds the replica-safe created-at fence floor.

name: 0022_event_ttl_refresh
migration_requirement: Preserve transactional ephemeral-channel TTL refresh and rollback semantics
summary: Refreshes event retention when ephemeral channel deadlines move.

name: 0023_push_match_gate
migration_requirement: Keep community push-match enablement fail closed during mixed-version operation
summary: Adds a community-level gate for push-match enqueueing.

name: 0024_event_ttl_refresh_shared_lock
migration_requirement: Retain the shared-lock repair for concurrent TTL refresh operations
summary: Repairs ephemeral retention under concurrent channel updates.

name: 0025_relay_invites
migration_requirement: Import invite uses expiries and revocations atomically
summary: Adds use-limited community relay invitations.

name: 0026_replica_heartbeat
migration_requirement: Preserve heartbeat freshness checks before routing reads to replicas
summary: Adds replica heartbeat and read-freshness evidence.

name: 0027_channels_id_lookup_index
migration_requirement: Recreate the channel-to-community covering index after import
summary: Adds a live channel identifier lookup index that includes community ownership.

name: 0028_long_reaction_payloads
migration_requirement: Preserve long custom-emoji reaction payloads without truncation
summary: Expands reaction payload storage for custom emoji.

name: 0029_community_deletion
migration_requirement: Import deletion requests leases manifests checkpoints and tombstones without executing destructive phases
summary: Adds the durable whole-community deletion control plane.

name: 0030_community_deletion_recovery
migration_requirement: Preserve terminal recovery state before any irreversible deletion work is approved
summary: Adds recoverable terminal states and control-plane repair support.

name: current_buzz_schema
migration_requirement: Compare migration replay output to this snapshot but keep ordered migrations as authority
summary: Represents the expected schema after all 30 Buzz migrations.

name: signed_events_and_projections
migration_requirement: Import through one Zed migration authority with counts hashes reconciliation and rollback
summary: Stores signed events plus community collaboration workflow Git moderation push audit and deletion projections.

name: media_blobs_and_sidecars
migration_requirement: Copy or adopt tenant-keyed objects with digest checks orphan reconciliation and rollback
summary: Stores original media thumbnails attachments and metadata sidecars in a private bucket.

name: git_objects_manifests_and_refs
migration_requirement: Preserve create-only content addressing verified reads and linearizable pointer CAS
summary: Stores immutable Git packs and manifests plus CAS-updated repository ref pointers.

name: hydrated_git_pack_cache
migration_requirement: Do not migrate; recreate from verified S3 Git objects and remove stale sessions
summary: Provides a byte-bounded process-local cache of immutable Git pack and index pairs.

name: event_fanout_topics
migration_requirement: Do not migrate payload state; reconnect and resubscribe from local desired-topic references
summary: Uses community-scoped channel and global pubsub topics for cross-replica realtime fanout.

name: typing_indicator_state
migration_requirement: Implement or explicitly retire the documented Redis typing contract before claiming parity
summary: The crate documentation advertises typing indicators and ZADD operations, but no typing module or Redis commands exist in the current source.

name: presence_leases
migration_requirement: Do not migrate; rebuild from authenticated connection heartbeats after cutover
summary: Stores community-scoped online or away values with a 180-second lease.

name: rate_limit_counters
migration_requirement: Drain or preserve the effective window during traffic cutover and fail closed on backend errors
summary: Stores fixed-window tenant and operator-global connection counters with expiry.

name: nip98_replay_claims
migration_requirement: Retain the active replay window or gate traffic until old claims expire; never dual-accept
summary: Stores first-claim NIP-98 event identifiers with bounded expiry and fail-closed errors.

name: cache_invalidation_topics
migration_requirement: Do not migrate; restart subscribers and invalidate all local tenant caches at cutover
summary: Publishes community-scoped cross-pod cache invalidation messages.

name: connection_control_topics
migration_requirement: Coordinate cutover so revocation and disconnect commands cannot be lost across active replicas
summary: Publishes community-scoped commands that close or refresh authenticated connections.

name: tauri_app_data_tree
migration_requirement: Import files before any identity or agent reader and retain conflict-safe backups until verified
summary: Contains identity agent persona team retention and app migration artifacts under platform app-data identifiers.

name: managed_agent_records
migration_requirement: Import agents/managed-agents.json atomically; preserve invalid backups and keyringless inline-key fallback
summary: Stores keyed agent instances and keyless reusable definitions with runtime configuration.

name: legacy_persona_records
migration_requirement: Fold personas.json into canonical signed persona state only after ordered JSON migrations
summary: Stores legacy persona definitions that are reconciled into retention events and the unified agent store.

name: team_records_and_bundles
migration_requirement: Import teams.json and agents/teams directories as one consistency boundary before signed-event publication
summary: Stores team metadata plus directory-backed instructions persona files skills and assets.

name: scoped_agent_retention
migration_requirement: Import every legacy and scoped retention database by owner and normalized relay with pending-sync reconciliation
summary: Stores persona team and managed-agent signed events for offline boot and relay synchronization.

name: local_event_archive
migration_requirement: Import archive.db without private keys; preserve scopes subscriptions raw events and rebuildable indexes
summary: Stores user-selected local event transcripts observer frames and parsed agent metric indexes.

name: human_and_agent_signing_keys
migration_requirement: Migrate with read-back verification rotation recovery and no secret logging; never duplicate keys silently
summary: Stores a namespaced secret blob for the human identity and managed-agent nsecs.

name: identity_key_fallback
migration_requirement: Adopt only after keyring write and read-back verification; preserve on keyring failure and quarantine corruption
summary: Stores the active human nsec in owner-only identity.key when the keyring is unavailable or migration is incomplete.

name: nip49_identity_backup
migration_requirement: Keep NIP-49 compatibility password verification safe KDF bounds and create-new portable export semantics
summary: Stores a password-encrypted identity.ncryptsec recovery artifact or user-selected portable copy.

name: legacy_webview_local_storage
migration_requirement: Read without mutation and import workspace active-workspace and onboarding keys idempotently
summary: Reads legacy WebKit localstorage.sqlite3 databases left by Sprout and Buzz application identifiers.

name: agent_nest
migration_requirement: Adopt the existing nest in place where safe; preserve user-authored files and exclude repository checkouts from blind copy
summary: Stores shared agent instructions skills research plans artifacts workspace links and runtime support files under .buzz or .buzz-dev.

name: repository_root_selection
migration_requirement: Map the selected root to canonical Zed project and worktree state without copying repositories
summary: Stores the active repository root in the nest .repos-dir marker.

name: managed_agent_runtime_receipts
migration_requirement: Import or expire receipts only after reconciling live processes; keep cleanup idempotent
summary: Stores per-runtime process receipts under agents/agent-pids for crash and orphan recovery.

name: managed_agent_and_install_logs
migration_requirement: Preserve user-visible logs through active job reconciliation and apply canonical retention after import
summary: Stores per-agent per-relay runtime logs and harness installation logs under agents/logs.

name: desktop_state_to_signed_events
migration_requirement: Run idempotently from JSON into scoped retention then relay; remove only after counts heads and pending state reconcile
summary: Converts persona team and managed-agent desktop records into signed retention events without creating a second final authority.

name: mesh_owner_keystore
migration_requirement: Preserve stable owner identity or explicitly rebind every advertised endpoint under ADR-006
summary: Stores the machine-scoped Ed25519 mesh owner keypair separately from Nostr identities.

name: user_owned_webview_state
migration_requirement: Import drafts manual-unread navigation notification and per-identity preferences without treating relay-derived snapshots as authority
summary: Stores workspace selection onboarding completion drafts read and unread overrides follows sections stars mutes sort order and navigation preferences.

name: webview_projection_snapshots
migration_requirement: Do not make caches authoritative; import only as offline bootstrap hints and evict on reconciliation mismatch
summary: Stores bounded channel message icon and profile snapshots with quota-recovery eviction.

name: desktop_presentation_preferences
migration_requirement: Map supported values into Zed settings and preserve unknown values for rollback
summary: Stores theme accent glass sidebar width zoom transcript animation and timestamp preferences.

name: webview_session_state
migration_requirement: Do not migrate across applications; reinitialize safely on launch or interrupted onboarding
summary: Stores pending welcome routing and temporary pane widths for one webview session.
